parameters.query:
WITH overdue AS (
    SELECT
        g.id,
        g.ticket_code,
        g.status,
        g.assigned_department
    FROM grievances g
    WHERE g.status IN ('Open', 'In Progress')
      AND COALESCE(g.updated_at, g.created_at)
          <= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM grievance_updates u
          WHERE u.grievance_id = g.id
            AND u.updated_by = 'Escalation Agent'
            AND u.update_note LIKE 'AUTO_ESCALATED:%'
      )
),
moved AS (
    UPDATE grievances g
    SET
        assigned_department = 'Admin Review (Escalated)',
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM overdue o
    WHERE g.id = o.id
    RETURNING
        g.id,
        g.ticket_code,
        g.status,
        o.assigned_department AS previous_department
),
logged AS (
    INSERT INTO grievance_updates (
        grievance_id,
        status,
        update_note,
        updated_by,
        created_at
    )
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        'AUTO_ESCALATED: Unresolved for 48 hours. Previous department: '
        || COALESCE(previous_department, 'Unassigned')
        || '. Sent to Admin Review.',
        'Escalation Agent',
        NOW()
    FROM moved
    RETURNING grievance_id
)
SELECT
    m.ticket_code,
    m.status,
    m.previous_department,
    'Admin Review (Escalated)' AS assigned_department
FROM moved m
JOIN logged l ON l.grievance_id = m.id;
